Name: Drug Consumables Pack
Author: SkribTheModder
Description:
In Stardew Valley, a mounting cost of living and cutthroat competition have driven several desperate merchants to dark dealings. Rumors are rampant that various established shop owners, once known for their integrity, have resorted to selling illegal drugs on the side in a desperate bid to make ends meet. The community now faces a moral dilemma as they grapple with the shocking revelation that their trusted neighbors may be involved in illicit activities to survive in these challenging times.

Various consumable drugs with different stat changes and effects are purchasable from several existing merchants. Please see below:

[b]Added Items, Stats, and Locations
[/b][u]Meth Brick[/u] - 5000g
Crafts x8 Meth [125 Energy, 56 Health] (+3 Speed, +15 Defence, Duration: 120 Seconds) -Purchasable from: [b]Clint[/b]

[u]Morphine Bottle[/u] - 1500g
Crafts x5 Morphine [50 Energy, 22 Health] (-2 Speed, +5 Defence, +2 Luck, Duration: 180 Seconds) Purchasable from:[b] Harvey[/b]

[u]Cigarretes 20 Pack[/u] - 500g
Crafts 20x Cigarette [3 Energy, 1 Health] (-1 Speed, +2 Luck, Duration: 60 Seconds) Purchasable from: [b]Pierre[/b]

[u]Ketamine 8 Ball[/u] - 1500g
Crafts x5 Ketamine [50 Energy, 22 Health] (-3 Speed, +3 Defence, +3 Luck, Duration 180 Seconds) Purchasable from: [b]Marnie[/b]

[u]Cocaine 8 Ball[/u] - 10000g
Crafts x5 Cocaine [250 Energy, 112 Health] (+5 Farming, +5 Foraging, +5 Mining, +5 Fishing, +5 Speed, +5 Luck, +200 Max Energy, Duration: 60 Seconds) Purchasable from:[b] Stardrop Saloon[/b]

[u]Magic Mushrooms Bag[/u] - 3000g
Crafts 8x Magic Mushrooms [25 Energy, 11 Health] (+2 Foraging, +6 Luck, Duration: 120 Seconds) Purchasable from: [b]Krobus
[/b][i]
[i]Please note: All purchased items are a type of seed, they are used to craft the consumble versions of the item, check the player crafting menu accordingly
Caution: Avoid carrying the seeds near plantable land as this may cause stability issues in some cases

[/i][/i][b]Install:
[/b]Just like every other mod, unzip the file, place the folder in your StardewValley/Mods Folder.

[b]Please ensure you have installed the latest version of the dependencies, otherwise, the mod will not function correctly.[/b]
